name: otp-input
title: OTP input
description: Enter a one-time code, one digit per box, with paste support.
a11y: The boxes are a group with a name; each box is labelled "Digit N of M".
Typing moves forward, Backspace moves back, arrows move, pasting fills all boxes.
inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="one-time-code" for mobile and autofill.
